mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS train_id, t.train_no, t.train_type, s.station_id, station.station_name, s.stop_order, s.arrival_time, s.departure_time, s.day_offset, s.mileage FROM train t INNER JOIN train_stop s ON s.train_id = t.id INNER JOIN station ON station.id = s.station_id WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.id, s.stop_order
SELECT p.train_id, p.segment_index, p.seat_type, p.price FROM train_segment_price p INNER JOIN train t ON t.id = p.train_id WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY p.train_id, p.segment_index, p.seat_type
